title: The real reason American health care is so expensive
speaker: Vox
zh: 【Vox】美國醫療保健如此昂貴的真正原因（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: I cannot tell you how obsessed I am with this chart.
cues.en: I cannot tell you how obsessed I am with this chart.
cues.zh: 我無法告訴你我對這張圖表有多著迷。

cues.text: It shows exactly what is wrong with America's conversation about health care.
cues.en: It shows exactly what is wrong with America's conversation about health care.
cues.zh: 它準確地表明瞭美國有關醫療保健的對話出了什麼問題。

cues.text: On one level, you've seen this chart before.
cues.en: On one level, you've seen this chart before.
cues.zh: 在某種程度上，您以前已經看過這張圖表。

cues.text: It shows health care spending as a share of the economy of a bunch of countries.
cues.en: It shows health care spending as a share of the economy of a bunch of countries.
cues.zh: 它顯示了醫療保健支出佔許多國家經濟的比重。

cues.text: There's Germany and France and Japan and Canada and oh! There's America.
cues.en: There's Germany and France and Japan and Canada and oh! There's America.
cues.zh: 有德國、法國、日本和加拿大，哦！那是美國。

cues.text: But now I want to add something you haven't seen to this chart.
cues.en: But now I want to add something you haven't seen to this chart.
cues.zh: 但現在我想在此圖表中新增一些您未曾見過的內容。

cues.text: This is how much of that spending in each country is private and how much is public.
cues.en: This is how much of that spending in each country is private and how much is public.
cues.zh: 這是每個國家的私人支出和公共支出的比例。

cues.text: Here's what's amazing: America's government spending on health care on programs like Medicaid and Medicare and the VA -
cues.en: Here's what's amazing: America's government spending on health care on programs like Medicaid and Medicare and the VA -
cues.zh: 令人驚奇的是：美國政府在醫療補助、醫療保險和退伍軍人管理局等專案上的醫療保健支出 -

cues.text: our versions of socialized medicine.
cues.en: our versions of socialized medicine.
cues.zh: 我們的社會化醫療版本。

cues.text: It's about the same size as these other countries.
cues.en: It's about the same size as these other countries.
cues.zh: 它的面積與其他國家大致相同。

cues.text: These countries where the government runs the whole health care system!
cues.en: These countries where the government runs the whole health care system!
cues.zh: 這些國家的政府管理整個醫療保健系統！

cues.text: And then there's our private spending.
cues.en: And then there's our private spending.
cues.zh: 然後是我們的私人支出。

cues.text: It's the private insurance system that makes health care in America so expensive.
cues.en: It's the private insurance system that makes health care in America so expensive.
cues.zh: 正是私人保險制度使得美國的醫療保健如此昂貴。

cues.text: Conventional wisdom says that the government is more expensive than the private sector.
cues.en: Conventional wisdom says that the government is more expensive than the private sector.
cues.zh: 傳統觀點認為政府比私營部門的成本更高。

cues.text: "It can't say no. It's corrupt, it's inefficient, it's slow."
cues.en: "It can't say no. It's corrupt, it's inefficient, it's slow."
cues.zh: “它不能說不。它腐敗，效率低下，速度緩慢。”

cues.text: "If you want something done right you give it to the private sector." That is what we hear in America all the time.
cues.en: "If you want something done right you give it to the private sector." That is what we hear in America all the time.
cues.zh: 「如果你想讓某件事做好，你就把它交給私營部門。」這就是我們在美國經常聽到的。

cues.text: And yet here we are with the biggest private sector spending the most.
cues.en: And yet here we are with the biggest private sector spending the most.
cues.zh: 然而，我們這裡最大的私部門支出最多。

cues.text: If you look at the data on physician visits and hospital discharges, you can get rid of one theory.
cues.en: If you look at the data on physician visits and hospital discharges, you can get rid of one theory.
cues.zh: 如果你看看醫生就診和出院的資料，你就可以擺脫一個理論。

cues.text: Americans don't consume more health care than people in these other countries.
cues.en: Americans don't consume more health care than people in these other countries.
cues.zh: 美國人並不比其他國家的人消耗更多的醫療保健費用。

cues.text: We don't go to the doctor more than the Germans or the Japanese. In fact we go to the doctor less.
cues.en: We don't go to the doctor more than the Germans or the Japanese. In fact we go to the doctor less.
cues.zh: 我們去看醫生的次數並不比德國人和日本人多。事實上，我們去看醫生的次數較少。

cues.text: The difference between us and them is that we pay more.
cues.en: The difference between us and them is that we pay more.
cues.zh: 我們和他們的差別就是我們付出的更多。

cues.text: Every time we go to the doctor for everything from an angioplasty to a hip replacement
cues.en: Every time we go to the doctor for everything from an angioplasty to a hip replacement
cues.zh: 每次我們去看醫生，進行從血管成形術到髖關節置換術等各種手術

cues.text: from a c-section to a pain reliever.
cues.en: from a c-section to a pain reliever.
cues.zh: 從剖腹產到止痛藥。

cues.text: In America, the price for the same procedure at the same hospital, it varies enormously
cues.en: In America, the price for the same procedure at the same hospital, it varies enormously
cues.zh: 在美國，同一家醫院做同樣的手術，價格相差很大

cues.text: depending on who is footing the bill.
cues.en: depending on who is footing the bill.
cues.zh: 取決於誰買單。

cues.text: The price for someone with public insurance like Medicare or Medicaid is often the lowest price.
cues.en: The price for someone with public insurance like Medicare or Medicaid is often the lowest price.
cues.zh: 擁有 Medicare 或 Medicaid 等公共保險的人的價格通常是最低的價格。

cues.text: These groups he covers so many people that the government can demand lower prices from hospitals and doctors
cues.en: These groups he covers so many people that the government can demand lower prices from hospitals and doctors
cues.zh: 他所涵蓋的這些群體如此之多，以至於政府可以要求醫院和醫生降低價格

cues.text: and they get those lower prices.
cues.en: and they get those lower prices.
cues.zh: 他們得到了更低的價格。

cues.text: If the doctors and hospitals say 'No' they lose a ton of business.
cues.en: If the doctors and hospitals say 'No' they lose a ton of business.
cues.zh: 如果醫生和醫院說“不”，他們就會失去大量業務。

cues.text: They lose all those people on Medicare all those people on Medicaid.
cues.en: They lose all those people on Medicare all those people on Medicaid.
cues.zh: 他們失去了所有享受醫療保險的人以及享受醫療補助的人。

cues.text: But there are hundreds of private insurance companies And they each cover far fewer people than
cues.en: But there are hundreds of private insurance companies And they each cover far fewer people than
cues.zh: 但私人保險公司有數百家，每家承保的人數都比

cues.text: a Medicare or a Medicaid.
cues.en: a Medicare or a Medicaid.
cues.zh: 醫療保險或醫療補助。

cues.text: And each one has to negotiate prices and hospitals and doctors are on their own.
cues.en: And each one has to negotiate prices and hospitals and doctors are on their own.
cues.zh: 每個人都必須協商價格，而醫院和醫生則自行決定。

cues.text: And if you're uninsured, you have even less leverage.
cues.en: And if you're uninsured, you have even less leverage.
cues.zh: 如果你沒有保險，你的影響力就更小了。

cues.text: Nobody is negotiating on your behalf.
cues.en: Nobody is negotiating on your behalf.
cues.zh: 沒有人代表你進行談判。

cues.text: So you end up paying the highest price.
cues.en: So you end up paying the highest price.
cues.zh: 所以你最終付出了最高的代價。

cues.text: One study found that most hospitals charge uninsured patients four times
cues.en: One study found that most hospitals charge uninsured patients four times
cues.zh: 一項研究發現，大多數醫院向沒有保險的患者收取四倍費用

cues.text: as much as Medicare patients for an ER visit.
cues.en: as much as Medicare patients for an ER visit.
cues.zh: 與 急診室就診的 Medicare 患者一樣多。

cues.text: Other countries, they don't have this problem.
cues.en: Other countries, they don't have this problem.
cues.zh: 其他國家則沒有這個問題。

cues.text: Instead of every private insurance company negotiating with every healthcare provider.
cues.en: Instead of every private insurance company negotiating with every healthcare provider.
cues.zh: 而不是每傢俬人保險公司都與每家醫療保健提供者進行談判。

cues.text: There's just this big list.
cues.en: There's just this big list.
cues.zh: 只有這麼大的清單。

cues.text: The country, the central government, they go and they say, "If you want to sell to us, to all
cues.en: The country, the central government, they go and they say, "If you want to sell to us, to all
cues.zh: 國家、中央政府，他們去說，「如果你想賣給我們，賣給所有人

cues.text: of our people, then here's what you can charge for a checkup. Here is what you can charge for an MRI
cues.en: of our people, then here's what you can charge for a checkup. Here is what you can charge for an MRI
cues.zh: 我們的員工，那麼這是您可以收取的檢查費用。這是 MRI 的收費標準

cues.text: or a prescription for Lipitor.
cues.en: or a prescription for Lipitor.
cues.zh: 或立普妥處方。

cues.text: And so then whether that bill goes to the heavily regulated private insurance companies in Germany or directly to the government
cues.en: And so then whether that bill goes to the heavily regulated private insurance companies in Germany or directly to the government
cues.zh: 那麼該法案是交給德國受到嚴格監管的私人保險公司還是直接交給政府

cues.text: like in the UK.
cues.en: like in the UK.
cues.zh: 就像在英國一樣。

cues.text: Each country is telling the doctor or hospital or drug company how much that bill will be.
cues.en: Each country is telling the doctor or hospital or drug company how much that bill will be.
cues.zh: 每個國家都會告訴醫生、醫院或製藥公司該帳單的金額是多少。

cues.text: And because the government controls access to all of the customers. It's an offer that hospitals
cues.en: And because the government controls access to all of the customers. It's an offer that hospitals
cues.zh: 而且因為政府控制著所有客戶的存取許可權。這是醫院的優惠

cues.text: and doctors and pharmaceutical companies typically can't refuse.
cues.en: and doctors and pharmaceutical companies typically can't refuse.
cues.zh: 醫生和製藥公司通常無法拒絕。

cues.text: "I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse." In America the idea is that you'll be a consumer.
cues.en: "I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse." In America the idea is that you'll be a consumer.
cues.zh: 「我將向他提出一個他無法拒絕的條件。 「在美國，人們的想法是你將成為消費者。

cues.text: That you'll do what you do when you go to Best Buy and buy a television.
cues.en: That you'll do what you do when you go to Best Buy and buy a television.
cues.zh: 當你去百思買購買電視時，你會做同樣的事情。

cues.text: But that just doesn't work in healthcare.
cues.en: But that just doesn't work in healthcare.
cues.zh: 但這在醫療保健領域行不通。

cues.text: It doesn't work in healthcare because you often come and get health care when you're unconscious, in an ambulance,
cues.en: It doesn't work in healthcare because you often come and get health care when you're unconscious, in an ambulance,
cues.zh: 它在醫療保健領域不起作用，因為你經常在失去知覺的情況下，在救護車上來接受醫療保健，

cues.text: when you're scared, when it's for your spouse or your child It is a time when you have the least bargaining power.
cues.en: when you're scared, when it's for your spouse or your child It is a time when you have the least bargaining power.
cues.zh: 當你害怕的時候，當為了你的配偶或你的孩子的時候，是你討價還價能力最弱的時候。

cues.text: You are not usually capable of saying, 'No.' You're not knowledgeable enough to do it,
cues.en: You are not usually capable of saying, 'No.' You're not knowledgeable enough to do it,
cues.zh: 你通常無法說「不」。你知識不夠，做不到

cues.text: you're not comfortable doing it, or you're not conscious enough to do it.
cues.en: you're not comfortable doing it, or you're not conscious enough to do it.
cues.zh: 你不習慣這樣做，或者你沒有足夠的意識去這樣做。

cues.text: That's why in other countries the government is a person who can say 'No' for you.
cues.en: That's why in other countries the government is a person who can say 'No' for you.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼在其他國家，政府是一個可以對你說「不」的人。

cues.text: You can say, 'No, that's too expensive you're going to have to lower your price' because they do have that power.
cues.en: You can say, 'No, that's too expensive you're going to have to lower your price' because they do have that power.
cues.zh: 你可以說，“不，那太貴了，你必須降低價格”，因為他們確實有這種能力。

cues.text: Anchor: A new push for single-payer health care right here in the US.
cues.en: Anchor: A new push for single-payer health care right here in the US.
cues.zh: 錨：美國對單一付款人醫療保健的新推動。

cues.text: Demonstrator: What do we want?
cues.en: Demonstrator: What do we want?
cues.zh: 示威者：我們想要什麼？

cues.text: Crowd: Single-payer!
cues.en: Crowd: Single-payer!
cues.zh: 眾人：單一付款人！

cues.text: Demonstrator: When do we want it?
cues.en: Demonstrator: When do we want it?
cues.zh: 示威者：我們什麼時候想要？

cues.text: Crowd: Now!
cues.en: Crowd: Now!
cues.zh: 眾人：現在！

cues.text: Anchor: California and others are saying maybe we should adopt the European model.
cues.en: Anchor: California and others are saying maybe we should adopt the European model.
cues.zh: 主持人：加州和其他國家都在說也許我們應該採用歐洲模式。

cues.text: Klein: If we decided to create a single-payer system with one of these huge price lists in the US
cues.en: Klein: If we decided to create a single-payer system with one of these huge price lists in the US
cues.zh: 克萊恩：如果我們決定建立一個單一支付系統，並在美國擁有這些巨大的價目表之一

cues.text: There would be nothing to stop lobbying from hospitals from doctors from
cues.en: There would be nothing to stop lobbying from hospitals from doctors from
cues.zh: 沒有什麼可以阻止醫生向醫院遊說

cues.text: drug companies. And those prices would get influenced.
cues.en: drug companies. And those prices would get influenced.
cues.zh: 製藥公司。這些價格將會受到影響。

cues.text: So we could end up with a single-payer system that is expensive. Even as expensive as
cues.en: So we could end up with a single-payer system that is expensive. Even as expensive as
cues.zh: 因此，我們最終可能會得到一個昂貴的單一付款人系統。即使像

cues.text: our current system.
cues.en: our current system.
cues.zh: 我們目前的系統。

cues.text: It all depends on how much you negotiate down the prices and now in America
cues.en: It all depends on how much you negotiate down the prices and now in America
cues.zh: 這完全取決於你談判降價的程度，現在在美國

cues.text: these groups have so much power because they are so rich.
cues.en: these groups have so much power because they are so rich.
cues.zh: 這些團體擁有如此大的權力，因為他們非常富有。

cues.text: That it's really hard to get them to bring down the prices.
cues.en: That it's really hard to get them to bring down the prices.
cues.zh: 讓他們降低價格確實很難。

cues.text: This is the irony of American healthcare: It's so expensive that it's become hard to make it cheaper.
cues.en: This is the irony of American healthcare: It's so expensive that it's become hard to make it cheaper.
cues.zh: 這就是美國醫療保健的諷刺：它太貴了，很難再便宜了。

cues.text: All that money they make, that becomes political power.
cues.en: All that money they make, that becomes political power.
cues.zh: 他們賺到的錢都變成了政治權力。

cues.text: And years and years and years of overpaying - those are huge industries now.
cues.en: And years and years and years of overpaying - those are huge industries now.
cues.zh: 年復一年地支付過高的費用——這些現在已經成為一個巨大的產業。

cues.text: And they have a lot of influence in Congress.
cues.en: And they have a lot of influence in Congress.
cues.zh: 他們在國會有很大的影響力。

cues.text: Under a single-payer system if we did drive prices down, doctors and hospitals
cues.en: Under a single-payer system if we did drive prices down, doctors and hospitals
cues.zh: 在單一付款人制度下，如果我們確實降低了價格，醫生和醫院

cues.text: they would be paid less than they are right now.
cues.en: they would be paid less than they are right now.
cues.zh: 他們的工資將低於現在。

cues.text: That might mean some of them close or some go out of business or some move.
cues.en: That might mean some of them close or some go out of business or some move.
cues.zh: 這可能意味著其中一些公司關閉，一些公司倒閉，或者一些公司搬遷。

cues.text: It would be really painful. One person's waste is another person's essential service or local hospital
cues.en: It would be really painful. One person's waste is another person's essential service or local hospital
cues.zh: 真的會很痛。一個人的廢物是另一個人的基本服務或當地醫院

cues.text: or their income. But then single-payer it's not an all-or-nothing choice.
cues.en: or their income. But then single-payer it's not an all-or-nothing choice.
cues.zh: 或他們的收入。但單一付款人並不是一個全有或全無的選擇。

cues.text: For instance, there's a really interesting section of Bernie Sanders Medicare-for-all bill.
cues.en: For instance, there's a really interesting section of Bernie Sanders Medicare-for-all bill.
cues.zh: 例如，伯尼·桑德斯的全民健保法案中有一個非常有趣的部分。

cues.text: Where he lays out this interim plan.
cues.en: Where he lays out this interim plan.
cues.zh: 他制定了這個臨時計劃。

cues.text: It's a plan he wants while he's setting up his new single-payer system.
cues.en: It's a plan he wants while he's setting up his new single-payer system.
cues.zh: 這是他在建立新的單一支付系統時想要的計劃。

cues.text: And in that plan, he expands Medicare to cover vision and dental.
cues.en: And in that plan, he expands Medicare to cover vision and dental.
cues.zh: 在該計劃中，他將醫療保險範圍擴大到視力和牙科。

cues.text: And he opens it to nearly everyone.
cues.en: And he opens it to nearly everyone.
cues.zh: 他幾乎向所有人開放。

cues.text: Not just people 65 and older.
cues.en: Not just people 65 and older.
cues.zh: 不僅僅是 65 歲及以上的人。

cues.text: All kids go on Medicare automatically and most adults can buy in.
cues.en: All kids go on Medicare automatically and most adults can buy in.
cues.zh: 所有孩子都會自動加入醫療保險，大多數成年人都可以購買。

cues.text: That plan, on its own, it wouldn't get American health care spending far down overnight.
cues.en: That plan, on its own, it wouldn't get American health care spending far down overnight.
cues.zh: 該計劃本身並不會讓美國的醫療保健支出在一夜之間大幅下降。

cues.text: But it would at least begin to recognize what we already know and what most other countries already do:
cues.en: But it would at least begin to recognize what we already know and what most other countries already do:
cues.zh: 但它至少會開始認識到我們已經知道的事情以及大多數其他國家已經在做的事情：

cues.text: That health care is one of those things the government can do cheaper and better than the private sector.
cues.en: That health care is one of those things the government can do cheaper and better than the private sector.
cues.zh: 醫療保健是政府可以比私營部門做得更便宜、更好的事情之一。
